scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend,workers "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:workers"
scripts.dev:tunnel: npm run predev:tunnel && concurrently -n frontend,backend,workers "npm run dev:frontend:tunnel" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:workers"
scripts.share: concurrently -n dev,tunnel -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:tunnel" "node scripts/wait_and_tunnel.cjs"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run check:backend
